title: Hymn of Divine Love (Jingrwai Jingieit Blei)
cultural_context: Classic devotional hymn singing of the omnipresent love and sustaining grace of God Almighty throughout the hills, from 'Ki Jingrwai Ai-nguh Blei' (1930).

khasi: Ka jingieit jong Me, ko Blei,
Ka jylliew palat ban ia ki duriaw;
Ka kiew sha lyndet ki khlur ba shai,
Ka tap ia ki lum bad ki madan;
Me ai ka jingshai ha ka miet ba dum,
Me pynkhie ia ka dohnud ba tlot;
Ngi ai nguh ia Me da ka kmen,
english: Your divine love, O God Almighty,
Is deeper far than the deepest seas;
Embracing every mountain ridge and plain;
You bestow radiant light in the pitch-dark night,
You revive and awaken the weary heart;
We offer our thanksgiving in joyful praise,
O supreme Creator of us all.

khasi: Wat la ki por ki la kylliang noh,
Ka jingisynei jong Me kam ju kut;
Me ri ia ngi kum ki khun ba ieit,
Ha pneh ba syaid jong ka hok;
To pynskhem ia ka jingngeit jong ngi,
Ban im da ka akor ba kyntang;
Haduh ba ngin da poi sha Me
Ha ka khet ba phyrnai junom.
english: Though eras shift and generations pass away,
Your boundless compassion never has an end;
You shelter us as Your beloved children,
Within the warm sanctuary of Your righteousness;
To live in sacred and upright conduct;
Until we arrive at last before You
At Your radiant throne throughout eternity.
